caṅkī.p: [Adhiccasamuppannanāma] (pu) CL=9 One who is named Caṅkī, Brahmin Caṅkī.
pn:
Caṅkī. A Mahā Sāla Brahmin, contemporary of the Buddha, reputed for his great learning and highly esteemed in Brahmin gatherings – e.g., at Icchānaṅgala (Snp., p.115) and at Manasākaṭa (DN.i.235).

He is mentioned together with such eminent and wealthy Brahmins as Tārukkha, Pokkharasādi, Jāṇussoṇī and Todeyya (e.g., MN.ii.202).

Caṅkī lived in the Brahmin village of Opasāda, on a royal fief granted him by Pasenadi. When the Buddha came to Opasāda, Caṅkī visited him, in spite of the protests of his friends and colleagues, and on this occasion was preached the Caṅkīsutta (MN.ii.164f).

We are not told that Caṅkī ever became a follower of the Buddha, though Buddhaghosa says that he held the Buddha in great esteem. MN-a.i.394; this also appears from the introductory part of the Caṅkīsutta.

caṅkīsutta.p: [Caṅkī+sutta] (na) Google Translate စင္ ကီ သုတ်၊ 'This is my opinion. It is the guardian of the truth with the five Dhammas of faith, pleasure, hearing, repetition, contemplation, and acceptance of the five Dhammas. See original
pn: Caṅkīsutta. Caṅkī, with a large company of Brahmins, visits the Buddha at Opasāda and finds him conversing with some eminent and aged Brahmins. A young Brahmin, called Kāpaṭhika, frequently interrupts the conversation and is rebuked by the Buddha. Caṅkī tells the Buddha that the youth is a very clever scholar and obtains for him a chance of questioning the Buddha. The Buddha declares that the Brahmin pretensions to possess the sole truth are vain, and goes on to explain how a man can come to have faith in truth, then gain enlightenment with regard to it, and finally attain the truth itself by means of practice and development. At the end of the discourse Kāpaṭhika declares himself a follower of the Buddha. MN.ii.164ff.
a: စင်္ကီသုတ္တ(န)

စင်္ကီသုတ်၊ 'ဤ ငါ့အယူသာမှန်၏၊ အခြားအယူသည် အချည်းနှီးသာ'ဟု တစ်ဖက်သတ် မဆုံးဖြတ်သောသူ၏ ယုံကြည်ခြင်း, နှစ်သက်ခြင်း, တစ်ဆင့်ကြားခြင်း, အခြင်းအရာကို အဖန်ဖန်ကြံဆခြင်း, အယူကို စဉ်းစားတွေးကြံ လက်ခံနှစ်သိမ်ကျေနပ်ခြင်းတရား ၅-ပါးတို့ဖြင့် အမှန်သဘောကို စောင့်ရှောက်ခြင်း(သစ္စာနုရက္ခဏ)ဖြစ်၏။ မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။
